% ko/book.tex -- the master file for the Korean edition.
% Hand-edited. Build with: finishing/tools/build_edition.sh ko
%
% Shared by every edition: the preamble (switched by \booklanguage,
% \booklocale and \bookmainfont), edition-common.tex (English captions, notes,
% heads) and edition-body.tex (the document). ko/sections.tex and
% ko/status.tex are GENERATED by finishing/tools/editions.py.
% Korean is set by luatexja in Noto Serif CJK KR (a system font); Latin keeps the English book's face.
% No babel locale is loaded (none for \booklocale): the CJK locales fight the
% typesetting package, so translated sections are set under English, which here
% governs only Latin hyphenation, and the heads and captions are the edition's own.
% biblatex has no Korean strings; the edition's own are in ko/biblatex-ko.lbx, mapped
% onto English so that every citation uses them.
% luatexko, the usual Korean package, requires kotex-utf, which is not installed
% here. luatexja sets Hangul as it sets kanji: it may break a line between any
% two syllables, where Korean typesetting often prefers a word boundary.
% Korean's spaces and Western punctuation pass through as ordinary text.
%
% The title, subtitle and notice are a language model's drafts, not yet
% reviewed by a native reader; the title itself is an open question (D-810).
\documentclass[11pt,oneside]{book}
\def\bookcode{ko}
\def\booklanguage{english}
\input{ko/status}
\newcommand{\booklegal}{%
     저작권 \textcopyright{} 2026 \bookauthor.\\
     CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 라이선스로 배포됩니다.\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     이 책에 인용된 제3자의 자료는 제사(題詞)를 포함하여\\
     해당 권리자의 소유이며, 공정 이용(fair use)에 따라 수록되었습니다.\\
     위 라이선스는 이 자료에 적용되지 않습니다.\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     한국어 번역은 진행 중입니다. 아직 번역되지 않은 절은 영어로 실려 있습니다.\\
     번역된 절은 언어 모델이 준비한 초안이며,\\
     아직 원어민의 검토를 거치지 않았습니다.%
     \ifx\editionstalelist\empty\else\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     다음 절은 번역을 갱신하는 동안 영어로 실려 있습니다:\\
     \editionstalelist.\fi}
\input{preamble}
% luatexja's default faces are Japanese ones not installed here; name the
% Noto CJK faces before it loads, or it stops on a missing font.
\makeatletter
\def\ltj@stdmcfont{name:NotoSerifCJKkr-Regular}
\def\ltj@stdgtfont{name:NotoSansCJKkr-Regular}
\makeatother
\usepackage{luatexja-fontspec}
\setmainjfont{Noto Serif CJK KR}[JFM=ujis, Language=Korean,
  BoldFont=Noto Serif CJK KR Bold, ItalicFont=Noto Serif CJK KR,
  BoldItalicFont=Noto Serif CJK KR Bold]
\addto\captionsenglish{\renewcommand{\contentsname}{차례}%
  \renewcommand{\appendixname}{부록}\renewcommand{\bibname}{참고 문헌}}
\newcommand{\edchapnum}{제\thechapter 장}
\newcommand{\edappnum}{부록 \thechapter}
\newcommand{\edpartnum}{제\arabic{part}부}
\DeclareLanguageMapping{english}{ko/biblatex-ko}
\input{edition-common}

\newcommand{\booktitlemain}{반파시스트 지능}
\newcommand{\booksubtitle}{거부할 수도 있는 기계, 그리고 그것을 빚어야 할 대중}
\newcommand{\bookauthor}{Joshua G. Stern}
\newcommand{\bookreferences}{참고 문헌}
\title{\booktitlemain: \booksubtitle}
\author{\bookauthor}
\date{}
\hypersetup{pdftitle={\booktitlemain: \booksubtitle}, pdfauthor={\bookauthor}}
\input{edition-body}
